messages.text: monthly opex today, gamma looks heavy around the 5500 strike in SPX. dealers pinned there into the close imo
Yep. What's our net delta looking like going into the afternoon? Anything sitting short calls we haven't rolled?
Book is roughly flat delta, but I've got a chunk of short 5500 calls expiring. Planning to roll out to the August 5550s unless it rips.
Heads up, OMS is a bit laggy on option routes this morning. Acks taking 2-3 sec vs usual sub-second.
Noted. Travis, are you seeing it on all venues or just the one?
Mostly CBOE routes. Equity cash looks fine. I'll keep an eye on it and ping Tech if it gets worse.
Also TradeBlotter P&L on the options book looks stale, still showing yesterday's marks on some legs. Anyone else?
Same here. Refresh didn't help. Probably lagging off pricing, I'd trust the OMS fills over the blotter until it catches up.
Reminder: no new size in the last 30 min unless it's closing out expiring risk. Pin risk is real, I don't want any surprise assignments over the weekend.
Understood. I'll start unwinding the short 5500s from 3:00 and keep the hedge in futures until it's flat.
I can work the unwind in slices through the afternoon. Want me on a TWAP or just hitting the bid near the close?
TWAP from 3:00 to 3:40, then I'll take the rest manually if there's anything left. Spreads usually widen after that.
Good plan. Post when you're flat on the expiring strikes so I can sign off.
Will do. Blotter marks look like they've refreshed now too, for what it's worth.
